title: SVOD, AVOD, TVOD: Video on Demand Models Explained
summary: Understand the differences between SVOD, AVOD, and TVOD. Learn how each monetization model impacts advertisers and viewers.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


What consumers and marketers need to know about SVOD, AVOD, and TVOD.


1. 1


SVOD charges recurring fees for broad on-demand content access.


2. 2


AVOD lowers viewer costs by monetizing content through advertising.


3. 3


TVOD lets viewers rent or purchase individual titles separately.


4. 4


Streaming growth increasingly depends on advertising revenue and profitability.


5. 5


MNTN turns ad-supported CTV audiences into measurable performance outcomes.
